subroutines.name: load_title_screen
subroutines.title: Load the title screen while output is off
subroutines.description: VDU 21, *LOAD SCREEN (the MODE 2 picture, to &3280), VDU 6. Called by title_start with every colour black, so the picture arrives unseen; VDU 21 keeps any filing system messages off the screen.

subroutines.name: leave_title
subroutines.title: Disable VDU output and run Coder
subroutines.description: VDU 21, then *CODER, which does not return. Called last by title_start, after the BREAK intercept is armed. VDU output stays disabled when Coder starts.

subroutines.name: title_start
subroutines.title: Set up, show the title and run Coder
subroutines.description: Disable ESCAPE, make the cursor keys return codes, set the level counter, the level digits and the menu tables in page &08 for Coder and the game, point the BREAK intercept at &15B5 (the game's next-level intercept), load and show the title screen, twinkle stars on it until a key is pressed, then select the game's display, arm the BREAK intercept and run Coder.

subroutines.name: mode2_cursor_off
subroutines.title: Select MODE 2 and turn the cursor off
subroutines.description: VDU 22,2 then VDU 23,0,10,&20,0,0,0,0,0,0 (6845 register 10: no cursor), from cursor_off_vdu.

subroutines.name: title_plot_star
subroutines.title: Plot a star frame on the title screen
subroutines.description: Exclusive-OR a 7-byte by 28-row frame of the star animation onto the MODE 2 screen at byte column plot_x and pixel row plot_y, row by row and left to right (or right to left if title_plot_reversed is set). A version of the game's plot_sprite with its own frames.

subroutines.name: title_screen_address
subroutines.title: Calculate a title screen address
subroutines.description: The game's screen_address, reading the row offsets from MOS 1.20's table at &C375.

subroutines.name: twinkle_stars
subroutines.title: Twinkle stars on the title screen until a key is pressed
subroutines.description: Up to three stars at once, each at one of the eight places in star_places_x and star_places_y, picked at random. A star grows through frames 0-6 and shrinks back through 5-0. A new star is tried for about one pass in four, by the low bits of the System VIA's timer 1. The keyboard is scanned from key 16 on, so SHIFT and CTRL alone do not end the title. When a key is pressed the stars still showing are erased, though the MODE change that title_start makes next clears the screen anyway.

subroutines.name: start_star
subroutines.title: Start a star at a free place
subroutines.description: Take the first star not showing, if any, give it frame 0 and step +1, choose a free place at random, mark the place taken and plot the first frame.

subroutines.name: advance_stars
subroutines.title: Advance each star by one frame
subroutines.description: For each showing star, erase the frame (exclusive-OR) and step it; past frame 6 it turns back at 5, and below 0 it is finished and its place freed. Then plot the new frame and pause, longer for a star not showing so the timing stays even.

subroutines.name: plot_star
subroutines.title: Plot star Y's current frame
subroutines.description: Call title_plot_star with the star's position and frame, keeping Y.

banners.name: star_frame_data
banners.title: Star frames
banners.description: Seven 7-byte by 28-row MODE 2 frames of the title screen's twinkling star, from small (frame 0) to large (frame 6).
